comments.summary: owns the sequential xun pipeline: world update, presentation children, force/unit simulation, then the ten-day date simulation
orders terminal evaluation, xun/monthly/quarterly event selectors, xun updates, quarterly updates, annual appearance, and cleanup
orders daily pre-command work, unit command events, date advance/daily map updates, unit/building events, and final date-display refresh
save header persists the authoritative scenario date code
save header restore writes the authoritative scenario date before record reconstruction
renders cached year/month/xun and seasonal calendar controls; it does not own the simulation date
returns one bounded year-table entry year; zero is the original invalid-entry sentinel
original conditional rejects a zero year-table entry; the third-party condition-byte change at 0x430153 adds negative-year support rather than exposing an original rule

evidence_summary: Current-sample xun and daily state machines, four periodic event tables, save header read/write, main-map derived date cache, and year-table/display host control flow close the observable time and ownership boundary without adopting third-party injected calendar semantics.
